templates.name: ACME Weekly MDR SOC Template
templates.foreword: This Executive Security Report provides an automated overview of SOC threat telemetry, prioritized security incidents, and operational key risk indicators.
templates.objectives: Our consultants are highly focused towards eliminating the noise (unwanted traffic, alerts) by identifying and prioritizing real actionable threats and help management take necessary preventive actions.
templates.desc: Customized Weekly template for ACME DEFENSE SYSTEMS.
